## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 418 captures during January 2022. This activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the reporting month. The capture total provides the basis for the subsequent image-quality review and grading outcomes. Records were considered together to support routine monitoring of service activity and the proportion of images progressing to clinical assessment.

## Image quality

Of the 418 captures, 10 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.4. These images could not proceed through the usual grading process and were therefore excluded from assessment of clinical findings. The result should be monitored as part of ongoing quality assurance, with attention to image acquisition and any recurring issues identified through local review.

## Grading

Grading identified 92 referable results from the images suitable for assessment. The median lag between capture and grading was 17 days. This measure provides an indication of the time taken for images to move through the grading process during January 2022. Activity, image quality and grading outcomes should continue to be reviewed together to support service oversight at North City Eye Clinic.
